mini_task_spec:
Using the NestJS repository located in `test-repo/`, identify all TypeScript source files within `test-repo/packages/core` (excluding any files inside `test/` subdirectories) that directly **import** (not re-export) from `metadata-scanner.ts`. A "direct import" means the file contains an `import` statement whose module specifier resolves to `metadata-scanner` (e.g. `'./metadata-scanner'`, `'../metadata-scanner'`, `'../../metadata-scanner'`). Re-export lines (`export * from './metadata-scanner'`) do not count.

List the matching file paths relative to `test-repo/`, one per line, sorted alphabetically.

Expected answer format example:
```
packages/core/discovery/discovery-module.ts
packages/core/middleware/routes-mapper.ts
...
```
